sentences.en: I'll give you my plush rabbit if you give me your squirrel.
sentences.zh: 如果你把你的松鼠给我，我就给你我的豪华兔玩偶。

sentences.en: The plush fur of the toy felt so soft and somehow soothing.
sentences.zh: 这个玩具的长毛绒很柔软，摸起来感觉很舒服。

sentences.en: The girl brought her favourite plush toy.
sentences.zh: 那个女孩带来了她最喜欢的豪华玩偶。

senses.zh: 豪华的；长毛绒做的；舒服的
